reviewedSince: From v8.0.7 publication through both FURU production tests and author-credit correction on 2026-11-19.

findings.observation: Action was successful at strong perspective but needed clearer speed and ink.
findings.rule: Keep composition and add directional speed lines, focused blur and pressure-tapered marks where the action reads.
findings.reason: Preserves approved acting and perspective while conveying speed.

findings.observation: Normal strokes disappeared against the color wash. POP already had suitable width.
findings.rule: Use readable pressure-tapered focal contours while retaining the specific media and finer facial detail.
findings.reason: Preserves distinct styles and makes normal panels legible at reading size.

findings.observation: A scene intended to show a sleeve crossing initially showed mainly an umbrella and an extra rendering of a character.
findings.rule: Trace the connected character silhouette into the receiving panel and count its local characters separately.
findings.reason: Uses the existing observed-versus-intended breakout check.

findings.observation: A decisive romance panel appeared eye-level and reordered balloons briefly swapped their speakers.
findings.rule: Show matching perspective cues in figures and nearby forms, and verify balloon sequence and speaker attachment separately.
findings.reason: Tests the drawing and dialogue directly.

findings.observation: Author credit appeared at the top of the final panel.
findings.rule: When requested, put author credit at the lower right and verify its wording, position and count. Use product watermarks only on the final page of a FURU-authored work by default.
findings.reason: Keeps independent credits, actual speech and page numbers readable.

findings.observation: A stale browser and its connection left a pending authorized production job.
findings.rule: Use normal installed startup and the in-chat browser. If the AI cannot operate the browser, ask for the actual pairing control and read back the same pending job.
findings.reason: Tracks the actual live browser, service, pairing and job independently.

checks.name: Skill verification
checks.evidence: Official structure validation of installed and repository skills. Strict MCP and skill ZIP extraction validation. Installed skill differs only by the user-specific G-pen preference, which stays local.

checks.name: Live production and visual comparison
checks.evidence: Saved and visually compared accepted AI Hunter color and monochrome pages and Umbrella pages, including G-pen and author-credit edits, and verified PNG/JSON correspondence. Fresh compiled v8.0.8 pairing and pricing tests passed 38 of 38.
